name: Sensei
source:
At a small age main character was under custody of his teacher older brother. Now he becomes aware of his feelings and desires. He can not forget those student-teacher relations of the past. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角小时候一直由当老师的哥哥照顾。如今他渐渐认清自己的感情和欲望，也始终忘不了过去两人以师生身份相处的那段时光。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
